Reason: Figure 1b demonstrates a marked rightward displacement and rotation of the cardiac silhouette into the empty right hemithorax, which is characteristic of right-sided cardiac herniation following pneumonectomy. This mechanical complication causes acute haemodynamic compromise by obstructing venous return and impairing cardiac output.
